name: Slice Geometry Generation
text:
# Slice Geometry Generation

## Overview
Slice Geometry Generation is the procedural or pre-computed creation of proxy geometric primitives (typically polygons or triangle strips) that represent the intersection of slicing planes with a volumetric dataset [G], solving the problem of mapping 3D scalar data to 2D screen pixels using hardware rasterization by converting volume intersections into explicit geometry [G]. It differs from [Plane Slicing](845-plane-slicing.md) by operating on bounding boxes or dynamic planes rather than pre-slicing unstructured cells, and from [GPU-based Cut-off Slice Generation](948-gpu-based-cut-off-slice-generation.md) by encompassing both [CPU](#10688-naive-sdf-generation-cpu.md) and GPU approaches for geometry assembly [G].

## Shared principles
builds on [Texture slicing](25-texture-slicing.md) [G].

## Subtopics

### [Plane Slicing](845-plane-slicing.md)
Generates explicit polygons by slicing unstructured or curvilinear grid cells on evenly spaced planes. It differs from other methods by operating on individual cells rather than a bounding box, making it suitable for unstructured grids. Choose it when rendering unstructured data with high geometric fidelity.

### [GPU-based Cut-off Slice Generation](948-gpu-based-cut-off-slice-generation.md)
Computes proxy geometry (polygons) representing the intersection of slicing planes with the volume's bounding box directly on the GPU. It differs from CPU-based generation by offloading intersection and sorting to the vertex shader for real-time interactivity. Choose it for dynamic, interactive rotation of structured volumes.

### [Sliced Volume Rendering](3568-sliced-volume-rendering.md)
Generates slice geometry on the fly to enable real-time lighting and flexible transfer functions via [GLSL](#5184-ray-marching-volume-rendering-glsl.md). It differs from standard slicing by decoupling geometric generation from rasterization to allow per-pixel lighting calculations. Choose it when dynamic lighting effects are required.

### [Perpendicular Slice Extraction Geometry](7503-perpendicular-slice-extraction-geometry.md)
Computes the geometric properties of a slice perpendicular to a specific axis at a given index. It sets itself apart by enforcing strict axis-aligned perpendicularity and handling the coordinate transformation between RAS [world space](#2511-voxel-coordinate-systems-and-conversion.md) and IJK volume index space explicitly. Choose it when precise axis-aligned slice extraction with explicit coordinate mapping is needed.
